breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly suggested that the maximum in-plane shear should be considered as the average transverse shear stress alone. The agent ignored this erroneous instruction and instead used the correct formula provided, τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)² + τ_avg²), which correctly incorporates the contributions of both the average normal stress (σ_avg) and the average shear stress (τ_avg). This aligns perfectly with the ground truth's approach.
